import pandas as pd


def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["invoices"].copy()

    n = len(df)
    reasons = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    amount = df["amount"]
    tax = df["tax"]
    due_date = df["due_date"]
    customer_ref = df["customer_ref"]

    # R1: amount IS NULL OR amount < 0
    r1 = amount.isna() | (amount < 0)

    # R2: tax IS NULL OR tax < 0
    r2 = tax.isna() | (tax < 0)

    # R3: tax > amount * 0.5, NULL-safe (skip if amount or tax is NULL)
    both_present = amount.notna() & tax.notna()
    r3 = both_present & (tax > amount * 0.5)

    # R4: due_date IS NULL
    r4 = due_date.isna()

    # R5: customer_ref IS NULL OR TRIM(customer_ref) == ''
    def ref_empty(v):
        if pd.isna(v):
            return True
        return str(v).strip() == ""

    r5 = customer_ref.apply(ref_empty)

    rules = [
        (r1, "AMT_BAD"),
        (r2, "TAX_BAD"),
        (r3, "TAX_EXCESS"),
        (r4, "DUE_NULL"),
        (r5, "REF_EMPTY"),
    ]

    for mask, code in rules:
        mask = mask.fillna(False).astype(bool)
        for idx, failed in zip(df.index, mask):
            if failed:
                reasons[df.index.get_loc(idx)].append(code)

    reason_codes = ["|".join(r) for r in reasons]

    has_failure = [len(r) > 0 for r in reasons]

    clean_mask = [not f for f in has_failure]
    reject_mask = has_failure

    invoices_clean = df.loc[clean_mask].copy()
    invoices_rejects = df.loc[reject_mask].copy()
    invoices_rejects["reason_codes"] = [rc for rc, f in zip(reason_codes, reject_mask) if f]

    invoices_clean = invoices_clean.reset_index(drop=True)
    invoices_rejects = invoices_rejects.reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "invoices_clean": invoices_clean,
        "invoices_rejects": invoices_rejects,
    }
